items.title: Court rules MDP presidential hopeful Shamheed liable for debt
items.summary: Failure to meet the constitutional qualifications can result in the loss of parliamentary membership.

items.title: Maldives working to reduce impact of fuel price, president says
items.summary: President Muizzu said the Maldives had set a target of generating 33% of its energy from renewable sources by 2033 as part of its national priorities.

items.title: President establishes advisory council
items.summary: President Muizzu will chair the council.

items.title: HPA urges public to take precautions as influenza cases rise
items.summary: The agency advised parents to monitor children experiencing fever and cold symptoms and seek medical attention without delay if warning signs develop.

items.title: Court authorises council to remove vessels from Vilimalé
items.summary: Under the ruling, Seashuttle Maldives must pay MVR 75,446 within 15 days and remove its vessels from the designated mooring areas within 10 days.

items.title: FDC imposes fines in 23 cases involving regulation violations
items.summary: The largest number of cases involved alterations made to housing units without approval.

items.title: Digital cards replace printed thalassaemia results in Maldives
items.summary: Under the new system, seven types of digital cards will be available, replacing the printed cards previously issued to indicate thalassaemia carrier status.

items.title: MIRA collects MVR 2.8B in Oct, exceeding forecast by 12.9%
items.summary: According to the authority, collections from overdue payments accounted for 19% of total revenue received during October.

items.title: MIRA responds to governor: Tax audits follow risk-based approach
items.summary: Munawwar called on MIRA to examine the financial records of resorts to determine whether their reported profits and tax declarations were accurate.

items.title: MVR 19B on land reclamation, much of it unused: Auditor General
items.summary: He stressed the need to ensure that public spending on land development generates benefits for the state.
